acquisition: Follow the official repository's Download section; manually extract the original L001-L004 PLY files and class/color sidecars into data/raw/toronto3d. No mirror or credentials are embedded here.

license.notice: Toronto-3D by Weikai Tan et al.; noncommercial use and attribution required. Consult upstream for citation and full terms.

crs: Source UTM coordinates; no reprojection; CRS not independently verified
checksum_provenance: PLY hashes, sizes and counts transcribed from the existing independently validated prepared/manifest.json; sidecar hashes computed from local original files. These are local reference checksums, not upstream-signed checksums.

converter.binary_reproducibility: Not claimed; compiler, linked dependencies and concurrent sampling may change binary/output ordering. Validate semantic identity instead.
